title: nbn service disruption - Howlong, NSW
current_summary:
Some nbn services in Howlong, NSW are affected. The issue was reported at about 11:43 am AEDT on 1 November 2026, and no restoration estimate has been provided yet.

nbn is working hard to resolve an unexpected network issue in your area causing a partial or total loss of connectivity to your nbn service. Using mobile data can help you stay connected if needed.
